theme: LENF + HASINF/STARTSF/ENDSF read-only payload field gates
prior_note: iter 142 CATFALL/REPLACEF/TRIMF mutators; this iter stresses LENF (679ba76) + HASINF (35c373b) non-mutating probes

tests.name: open_payloads
tests.cmd: open a0 /tmp/out.json note timeout; a1 /var blank note

tests.name: hasinf
tests.cmd: timeout hit; missing soft; REQUIRE→2; HASIFI ERROR

tests.name: admit
tests.cmd: compound gate admit→status admitted; a1 deny

tests.name: probe
tests.cmd: TRY* soft; empty needle HASINF hit=1

weaknesses.title: NOTE command clobbers variable named NOTE
weaknesses.detail: NOTE "action open" overwrites LET/DEFAULT NOTE used for payload body — dump showed note:action open. Agents must not name vars NOTE (use MSG).
weaknesses.repro: DEFAULT NOTE=...; NOTE "action open"; open uses NOTE → action open

weaknesses.title: Empty ENV string treated as missing (LAST_N=0)
weaknesses.detail: CUBALC_FS_NOTE="" does not override DEFAULT MSG; cannot clear default via empty env without sentinel.
weaknesses.repro: FS_NOTE="" open a2 still default note

weaknesses.title: HASINF empty needle always matches
weaknesses.detail: HASINF note "" → 1 even for non-empty fields. Agents must reject blank needles before probe.

weaknesses.title: No fleet LENWHERE/HASINWHERE — per-object only
weaknesses.detail: Fleet admit still loops slots; WHERE family is numeric/status match not substring/len probes.

weaknesses.title: LENF on numeric field returns decimal digit length
weaknesses.detail: retries 42 → LENF_N=2 not magnitude; easy misread for quotas.

weaknesses.title: Probe sets LAST to field text — EQS clobbers LAST_N
weaknesses.detail: Capture LENF_N/HASINF_N immediately before string EQS.
weaknesses.repro: LENF then EQS LAST loses length in LAST_N

workarounds: Never name a var NOTE; use MSG/BODY
Use sentinel for empty override (e.g. - for blank note) not empty ENV
Fixed a0/a1/a2 slots; TRY* for soft probes
language_gaps: NOTE command must not bind/overwrite user var NOTE
issues_faced: NOTE var clobbered by NOTE cmd — renamed MSG
admit compound path+len+needle → admitted; blank a1 deny
empty ENV cannot clear default MSG
